title: How Lewis came to play in Evan Thomas's band
summary: Lewis recalls going to Lafayette with Chris Kelly, the new Evan Thomas band forming, rehearsals and a planned Mexico trip.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

Oh, well, I did. Ruffin's, I remember mentioning that this, that this, poor man, poor man, not poor man, he's an ordinary poor, uh, Ruffins.
